column1: # PERK v2.2.0 (specification 20/12/2025), the official submission package from
# https://pqc-perk.org/resources.html (zip; sha256 pinned in .source, checked by the
# Makefile). There is no public upstream git repository. Optimized_Implementation/
# aes_aes/ (AVX2 + AES-NI + PCLMUL; AES for both PRG and commitments): the
# instantiation of spec Table 9, whose cycle counts the YAML carries. Sizes match each
# set's api.h/parameters.h and data/schemes/PERK.yaml (sk = 16-byte seed + pk, as in
# the NIST API); our build reproduces the shipped aes_aes KATs for all 6 sets.
# PERK-5-short needs more than 8 MB of stack (the harness thread has 256 MB).
# Columns: file, name, pk, sk, sig, iters, dir (Optimized_Implementation/aes_aes/<dir>)
